references.registered: R-clear, registered code-blind at tag fr7-references-registered-2026-11-19, amended at fr7-references-amendment1-2026-11-19, landed at fr7-references-landed-2026-11-20
references.read: the interface only: inputs.json's clearance_cases and clearance; clearance.json's synthetic_cases; clearance.hill_drive(c, K, n) and clearance.t_clear(rows_s, D, epsilon) by the call forms REFERENCES_USAGE.md gives. clearance.c_star and clearance.can_release are not called or read

worlds.base: W2_dose_m3_t60 of inputs.json, by chain_mapper: the cell, the K population at N0 = 1e4, the template's dose and clearance, the Hill factor routed onto the unit producer's assembly rate by species_regulated_availability@2, the finite precursor, three maturation stages at 0.1/s and removal at ln 2/60 per second on all of N
worlds.base_equals_case: compartment_mapper.check_base refuses a world unless W2's template (dose 0.2 fmol, production [[0, 0]], clearance ln 2/20 per second), its factor (Hill activation, K 0.01 mM, n 2, basal 0.02) and the cell's volume (2 pL) equal the clearance cases' cytosol block
worlds.compartment: cell_owned_compartments@1: a finite outside node of the cell, bounded by one patch that no species crosses, holding the case's template amount, the precursor at the trace (1e-15 mM) and the owner's starting ion concentrations, its content neutral at a zero charge anchor (unit_turnover_fixtures.with_compartment)
worlds.release: scheduled_species_exchange@1's first-order import on the bounding patch, whose rate constant out of the node is kappa = k_u A 1e15 / V_o; k_u = kappa V_o / (A 1e15) from the case's release schedule (unit_turnover_fixtures.release_velocity). It reads the patch area current (D191); nothing changes the area here, so it reads the declared area bit for bit

layout_not_physics.note: the release depends on them only through kappa, which is the case's, and no ion crosses the bounding patch

worlds.rows_s: the clearance cases' rows: every 10 s from 0 to 1000 s (101 rows)
worlds.runner: the windowed runner (execution.windows.iter_windows), every step checked, the rows kept

c_star.clause_2: c* at a row = (the cell's n_T + the compartment's n_T where it counts) / V, V = 2 pL
c_star.clause_4: the compartment counts at row t when its declared release rate is positive on some interval starting at or after t: the rate in force at t (the last change at or before t) or any later change's rate; the schedule is read from the world's definition (its exchange_controls)
c_star.drive: D = clearance.hill_drive(c*, K, n), K 0.01 mM and n 2

judged.J1: t_clear from the engine's c* rows equals the case's registered t_clear: C2 680 s, C5 460 s
judged.J2: the compartment plant with power in each case, applied to the engine's rows, gives its registered outcome: in C2, compartment_left_out (c* from the cell alone) 620 s; in C5, sealed_compartment_counted (the compartment counted at every row) not cleared
judged.verdict: passed when J1 and J2 hold in both worlds, each run to 1000 s at dt = 1 ms by compartment_comparison.py from a frozen snapshot of main

coarseness: J1 and J2 are outcome equalities, coarse in D: a row moves only for an error of about 10% in D at C2's crossing (registered D/epsilon 0.90 at 680 s and 1.19 at 670 s) and about a third at C5's (0.75 at 460 s and 1.49 at 450 s). Near the crossing D is about (c*/K)^2 and C2's c* decays at the release rate, so C2's crossing moves for an error of about 0.5% in that rate
information: the other compartment plant's outcome against its registered one (no power in its case): in C2, sealed_compartment_counted 680 s; in C5, compartment_left_out 460 s
c* and D against the cases' exact rows: the largest relative deviation and its row
the bracket (D/epsilon at t_clear and at the row before) against the registered bracket
the chain's rows (N, PA, V, M_j, n_P, W, R, C_P, the material total, F_T, Na, K, Cl): no registered reference covers a chain fed by a compartment, so none is judged
the template's account over the cell and the compartment: the cell's change, the release's moved amount and turnover's cleared amount, and the compartment's change against the release
not_evaluated: R-clear's other plants (the first crossing, the threshold on the factor, the strict inequality and the end time), which need no compartment; R-clear's own cases cover them
stop_rule: a refusal or exception during a run is that run's recorded outcome, and its readings are not met
a failed reading is kept as a finding; there is no rerun with changed criteria or inputs without the lead's word
smoke and development runs (a shorter horizon, or a tree other than main's frozen snapshot) are never judged
